responsibility: Supplies LoongArch target overrides for GNU/glibc-style userlands and related libc environments. It defines ABI-dependent dynamic linker paths, linker specs, fast-math start/end file handling, wide-character properties, C preprocessor defaults, and GNU userspace builtins such as _GNU_SOURCE for C++, integrating the LoongArch target with GCC’s generic GNU user and ELF linking framework.
